cells.gaps: No source found says the APD has published a list of adequate countries, model contract terms or a general authorisation, or that Angola has ratified the Malabo Convention.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): Law 22/11 sets a condition on transfers abroad [AGO-003], which answers question 1. Transfers to adequate countries need only notice, no general localisation rule is held, and so question 2 is a yes [AGO-003][AGO-011]. No published way to send data without asking is held, so the run stops at 3.
